common.initial_state: empty protocol caches, full buckets, all named links HELLO-admitted before t=0
common.hash_encoding: seed:u64be || domain_len:u16be || domain:ASCII || source:u32be || destination:u32be || object:u64be || fragment:u16be || attempt:u32be
common.hash_rule: SHA-256; independent domain values traffic,holdoff,loss; first u64be for loss < floor(p*2^64); holdoff min_ms + first_u64 % (max_ms-min_ms+1)
common.event_order: time, then completion/arrival before timer before scheduling, then node ID, then local sequence ascending
common.traffic_msg_id: first 8 bytes of SHA-256 encoded traffic tuple; regenerate fixture if any duplicate
common.trace_digest: SHA-256 over canonical event JSON lines (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, newline), synthetic IDs only

live_workload.origin_rule: event index modulo node count, ascending IDs
live_workload.sender_rule: unique synthetic sender per scheduled origin
live_workload.payload_recipe: timestamp=0, avatar=0, nickname ASCII n repeated20, cosmetics=00000000, text ASCII x repeated280; msg_id from seeded rule

stress_repeats.delivery: report loss separately, no lossless delivery threshold; retain static TTL-reachable scheduled-pair denominator and report outage-affected cohort separately without filtering out failures

sync.fixture_status: 1024-byte sizing envelope is arithmetic-only; actual signed556 and final MC-008 encrypted fixtures required for codec/crypto gates
